title: La Luz (SFF2026)
synopsis: Manuel is a provincial priest preparing to hang up his robes when his dark past comes to light, forcing him to face his actions. Seeking absolution, he approaches the youth he once harmed, inadvertently reopening old wounds. Directed by Fernando Franco from the abuser's perspective, takes an unflinching look at sin and its hidden consequences. It challenges religious institutions and asks a haunting question: can a sinner's guilt ever truly bring comfort to those they have broken?

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Manuel 是一位深受愛戴的小鎮神父，正當他準備脫下祭衣時，沉重的過去卻被教會揭發。他試圖尋覓當年受害的青年贖罪，殘忍地再次撕開受害者的傷口，跪求赦免。然而，寬恕的權利究竟落於何處？是叫人寬恕人七十個七次的上主，還是深受其害的人？導演 Fernando Franco 以施害者的角度出發，毫無保留地直視人類的罪行，反思施害者不可挽回卻無形的後果，掀起對宗教體制的拷問：愧疚之心，能否為受害者帶來慰藉？
